instruction: Adjust LibreOffice Impress settings to set undo steps to 50.

metadata.explanation: This task requires changing the number of undo steps in LibreOffice Impress from the default (usually 20) to 50. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu file for the Steps value under /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Undo. Similar complexity to original - both involve accessing Tools > Options and modifying a single numeric setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches the LibreOffice configuration file from the correct path (/home/user/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu)
Metric logic correctly parses XML and navigates to the right path (/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Undo) to extract the Steps property
Comparison logic is correct: extracts integer value from XML and compares against expected value of 50
Expected value (50) matches the instruction requirement exactly
Complete coverage: single-step task is fully verified by checking the undo steps setting
Proper error handling for XML parse errors, file not found, and None values
No state timing issues: LibreOffice config file is persistent and automatically saved when settings change
Correct parameter handling: metric function directly accesses rules['steps'] as expected for type='rule'
